rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a beef steak.

example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 maan5 soeng2 sik6 ngau2 paa2

rows.meaning: steak of other meat or veg
rows.note: Use this for a thick steak cut from non-beef meat, while vegetable versions usually need a more specific description.

example.english: This thick meat steak is enough for two people.
example.traditional: 呢塊肉扒厚身，兩個人食先夠。
example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 juk6 paa2 hau5 san1 loeng5 go3 jan4 sik6 sin1 gau3
